searchText: <@402853454126776320> , can you confirm whether your fix for eth_call, trace_call and eth_simulate has been merged already? Not yet Its here: https://github.com/ethereum/go-ethereum/pull/35845 Fyi, it looks like all other ELs cap `eth_call` execution gas as well! So geth#35845 is the only fix that I (claude) can find on my end. Reth added the cap on purpose in reth#27633, so it would just need reverting 😄
